game_concept: A speed quiz set in Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault, a hidden relic vault: the rune scholar must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Length Limit: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Relic Vault.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault: a hidden relic vault
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Declare char: declare resource as char, apply resource + 69, and print each result with %c. Dataset 4 starts with [0, 1, 2, 3]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Length Limit' (Week 7 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Relic Vault'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Eldritch Ruins

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.

source_player_objective: Collect 550 points of moon crystals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 550, or lives reach 0.
hint: Declare before use. char resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %c.
